data.name: Allister
data.gender_notes: Allister is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old English name Ælfric, Ælf-geweorc, meaning 'Noble, Elf-ruler, Elf-worker'. This name was popular in medieval England and Scotland. The name Allister carries the meaning “Ruler, Commander, Noble” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Allister usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler, commander, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Allister is a name of great power and leadership. It carries the energy of ancient wisdom, strength, and bravery. It inspires one to rise above challenges and to stand tall in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Allister belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler, Commander, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Allister total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: אליסטר
in_hebrew.meaning: אליסטר הוא מגן האלוהים משמר ומגן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אליסטר הוא שם שמקורו מהשפה הסקוטית ומשמעותו 'מגן האלוהים' או 'משמר ומגן'. השם אליסטר נגזר מהשפה הגאלית והוא מורכב משני חלקים: 'אליס' שפירושו אלוהים ו'טיר' שפירושו משמר או מגן. השם אליסטר הוא שם נפוץ בקרב הנוצרים ומשמש כזכר לשם אלוהים כמגן וכמשמר.

in_greek.name: Αλίστηρ
in_greek.meaning: Αλίστηρ ο Θεός είναι ο φύλαξ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αλίστηρ προέρχεται από τη Σκωτία και σημαίνει 'ο Θεός είναι ο φύλαξ' ή 'προστάτης του Θεού'. Το όνομα Αλίστηρ είναι σύνθετο από δύο μέρη: 'Αλί' που σημαίνει Θεός και 'στηρ' που σημαίνει φύλαξ ή προστάτης. Στην παράδοση των Χριστιανών, το όνομα Αλίστηρ συμβολίζει τη δύναμη και την προστασία του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Allister
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Allister originem habet in Scotia et significat 'Deus protector est' vel 'tutela Dei'. Nomen Allister ex duobus partibus constat: 'Alli' quod significat Deus et 'ster' quod significat protector vel tutela. In traditione Christiana, nomen Allister exprimit potentiam et tutelam Dei.

in_english.name: Allister
in_english.meaning: Defender of God or Protector of God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Allister originates from Scotland and means 'Defender of God' or 'Protector of God'. It is derived from the Gaelic language, composed of 'Alis' meaning God and 'tair' meaning defender or protector. In Christian tradition, Allister symbolizes the strength and protection of God. Historically, the name has been used to signify a person who is a guardian or a shield against evil. The name Allister has been popularized in various Christian cultures, emphasizing the spiritual significance of divine protection.

data.cultural_impact: The name Allister, derived from the Old English name Ælfric, holds a rich historical significance. This name was prominent in medieval England and Scotland, evoking images of the noble and powerful rulers of the time. Allister contains the Old English origins of the words 'elf' and 'work', suggesting a connection to the mythical beings of Anglo-Saxon and Celtic folklore. This name could signify an individual with a compelling past, rooted in the rich history of the Christian tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Allister symbolizes a unique connection to the divine elements of ancient mythology and Christianity. It carries the spiritual meaning of 'Noble Ruler', affirming an individual's potential to govern their thoughts, actions, and emotions accordingly. The 'Elf-worker' analogy suggests a deep-rooted respect for the inherent interconnectedness of the created world, reminding us of our innate spiritual connection with the divine and our role as stewards in actively shaping our lives and the world around us. This inspiring name calls forth a sense of courage, purpose, and spiritual awareness, encouraging those bearing the name to live a life rooted in honor, integrity, and a dedication towards personal growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Allister: God's pledge to the highest order. A name of dedication to divine guidance and protection.
